title: Signal: Apache error log served as a response
scope: One response body containing Apache error-log entries.
limitations: One response body. The rule recognises the Apache error-log prefix; a framework log with a different format is not reported.

observation.body:
[Sun May 11 09:14:02.123456 2024] [core:error] [pid 812] [client 203.0.113.7] AH00037: Symbolic link not allowed or link target not accessible: /var/www/shop/uploads
[Sun May 11 09:14:09.000111 2024] [php:warn] [pid 812] PHP Warning:  include(/var/www/shop/config.php): failed to open stream
[Sun May 11 10:02:44.442311 2024] [core:error] [pid 900] [client 10.1.2.3] script not found or unable to stat: /var/www/shop/admin/db.php

fpNotes: A page that quotes one log line is reported when the full prefix is present; a monitoring dashboard that summarises errors is not reported.
